description: Real CapCenter conventional fixed-rate quotes (30, 20 and 15-year) for a purchase, refinance or cash-out refinance scenario in a county CapCenter serves: rate, APR, points, monthly principal and interest, ZERO Closing Costs, and a required_disclosure for any rate, APR or payment. Inputs are rounded before pricing. Answers in Spanish with language=es (cotización hipotecaria). Also returns an apply link.

balance.description: Refinance and cash-out only (required): the mortgage balance being replaced, whole dollars.

cashOut.description: Cash-out only (required): cash out, whole dollars.

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages (/mortgage-rates/{state}/{slug}), e.g. henrico-county or richmond.

credit.description: Credit score band (620 is the minimum).

down.description: Purchase only: down payment in whole dollars, 3–90% of value. If omitted, 20% down is assumed and the response sets down_payment_assumed.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are quoted.

value.description: Home value (the purchase price on a purchase), whole dollars.

name: get_mortgage_quote
title: Get a CapCenter mortgage quote
